summary: Tested 'Resend Meeting Info' feature for scheduled appointments. Backend endpoint POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/appointments/resend works correctly with both appointment_id and appointment_index fallback. UI shows 'Resend Meeting Info' button on each saved appointment row. Clicking button calls API and shows success toast. All existing appointment add/save/delete behaviors remain intact. No regressions to Update/Delete/Convert actions.
critical_code_review_comments: leads.py: ResendAppointmentRequest model correctly supports both appointment_id and appointment_index for flexibility
leads.py: _send_single_appointment_notification() reuses existing email building logic - good code reuse
AdminLeadsKanban.jsx: handleResendAppointmentInfo() correctly handles loading state with resendingAppointmentKey
AdminLeadsKanban.jsx: Resend button shows Mail icon and loading spinner during API call - good UX
seed_data_creation: Created test leads with appointments during backend testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resend Meeting Info feature is fully implemented and tested.
